## What it is

A 5.1 x 34 mm printed alignment pin for the stacked mast joint. Print four.

## Design notes

The lower mast's top socket is a full 18 mm cylinder, but the upper mast's bottom socket has a 45-degree conical roof required for support-free printing. The old 36 mm pin incorrectly treated both as fully usable 18 mm cylinders and could hold the mast faces apart. This pin is 34 mm long and retains approximately 17 mm engagement in each mast.

The pin prints upright on its full-width flat end. Its upper end receives a 1 mm taper. During assembly, insert the **tapered pin end into the non-tapered mast end**, whose internal socket has the conical roof; the flat pin end enters the externally tapered mast end, whose internal socket is fully cylindrical.

The first 5.0 mm model fit but wobbled slightly. A 5.2 mm revision initially improved the fit, but the latest shortened print felt too tight. The user confirmed 5.1 mm as the working new mast-pin diameter, so that is the production default for the 5.4 mm socket. The external mast joining collar handles residual joint rocking rather than increasing the pin diameter.

## Don't

Do not restore the 36 mm length: it ignores the usable-depth reduction from the bottom socket's conical roof and may prevent the mast faces from closing. Do not taper the print-bed end: the attempted double-taper pin produced a first-layer bevel and reduced the footprint of this tall, narrow print. Do not restore 5.2 mm as the production default after the user confirmed 5.1 mm for the new pin. Do not use a 5.3 mm pin: physical testing made it seize and break inside the stopped mast socket. Do not rely on one pin per mast joint; the pair prevents rotation.

## Changelog

- 2026-08-07: Added for the support-free stacked mast joint.
- 2026-08-07: Shortened from 40 to 36 mm to match the corrected stopped sockets.
- 2026-08-07: Increased diameter from 5.0 to 5.2 mm after the printed fit showed slight wobble.
- 2026-08-07: User confirmed the printed 5.2 mm pin fits much better; retained as the proven default.

- 2026-08-09: Shortened the pin to 34 mm after the unequal usable socket depths were confirmed on the printed masts.
- 2026-08-09: Rejected a double-ended taper because it weakened the print-bed footprint; retained one tapered end with explicit assembly orientation.
